AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  OCTOBER 20, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 830 8401 3609; PASSWORD: 662749 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM
OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
agendas-393.
  5:45 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION  PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE 54956.9(d)(4): Initiation of Litigation in one case.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Councilmember Ramirez

FLAG SALUTE
  Vice Mayor Ayala

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
  City Council to Proclaim Respiratory Care Week in the City of Norwalk October 25 - 31, 2020.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of October
  6, 10, and 13, 2020. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period September 6, 2020
  through September 19, 2020, in the total amount of $886,205.88. 630

  Report
   3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  September 30, 2020 through October 13, 2020, in the total amount of $1,342,560.63. 640

  Report

  4.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – OCTOBER 14, 2020 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Synopsis

  5.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-65 - DESTRUCTION OF OBSOLETE RECORDS – CITY CLERK AND
  RECREATION AND PARK SERVICES DEPARTMENTS - Staff recommends City Council adopt
  Resolution No. 20-65, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  AUTHORIZING THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN RECORDS IN THE CITY CLERK AND
  RECREATION AND PARK SERVICES DEPARTMENTS. 870-02

  Report

  6.  PROJECT NO. 7438 – REJECT BID OF ADVANCED METERING INFRASTRUCTURE (AMI) SYSTEM
  INSTALLATION PROJECT – PHASE 2 - Staff recommends City Council reject the submitted bid for the
  Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) System Installation Project – Phase 2. 1005-04-7438

  Report

  7.  PROJECT 3305-2069 - ACCEPT WORK FOR PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF LIGHT
  EMITTING DIODE (LED) FIXTURES FOR CITY-OWNED STREET LIGHT POLES - Staff recommends
  City Council accept the work of Siemens Mobility Inc., of Austin, Texas for the purchase and installation
  of Light Emitting Diode fixtures for City-owned street light poles, including smart nodes, software, and
  training in the amount of $1,385,811.50; and authorize the City Manager to sign the Certificate of Final
  Completion and Acceptance form. 1030

  Report

  8.  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION APPROVAL OF BLUE CURB AT 12054 HOPLAND STREET - No
  action is required unless the City Council elects to review the decision of the Public Safety Commission
  regarding approval of the blue curb. 602-01

  Report

  9.  AGREEMENT – ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT SERVICES - Staff recommends City Council approve
  an agreement not to exceed $50,000 with Kosmont Companies to assist the City with tasks required for
  the implementation of the Economic Development Opportunities Plan; and authorize the City Manager
  to execute the agreement and any amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of
  the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 325

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  10. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

REPORTS

  11. PROJECT NO. 7182 – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK FOR STREET REPAVING OF ALONDRA
  BOULEVARD FROM STUDEBAKER ROAD TO GRIDLEY AVENUE, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-
  15 - Staff recommends City Council accept the work of All American Asphalt of Corona completed to
  date in the amount of $30,817 for the repaving improvements on Alondra Boulevard between
  Studebaker Road and Gridley Road. 1005-04-7182

  Report
   12. AGREEMENT AMENDMENT – WASTE COLLECTION SERVICES – Staff recommends City Council
  approve Amendment No. 1 to the Solid Waste Franchise Agreement with Athens Services; and
  authorize the Mayor to execute the amendment on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City
  Attorney. 1065-05-03

  Report

  13. RESOLUTION NO. 20-66 - FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 BUDGET REVIEW AND REVISIONS – Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-66, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AMENDMENTS TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 BUDGET.
  610

  Report

  14. NOVEMBER MEETING SCHEDULE – Staff recommends City Council either:

  a.  authorize holding one regularly scheduled meeting on November 17, 2020; or

  b.  adopt Resolution No. 20-67, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK CANCELING THE NOVEMBER 3, 2020 MEETING AND RESCHEDULING TO
  NOVEMBER 4, 2020. 825

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated October 15, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
